scenarios.prompt: A character approaches a mantle ledge. Define reach, normal, ledge and destination-clearance probes plus attach/crest/detach states without mandating physical buttons.

criteria.geometry: A valid candidate requires explicit geometry and destination-clearance evidence.
criteria.ownership: Traversal states are owned here while physical mappings stay in input-design and fall consequences in fall-rules.
criteria.evidence: Tests reachable/unreachable/blocked/interrupted cases and records transition reason instead of visual-only success.
